claim_boundary: Wave 35 narrows the policy-source gap to formula extraction and acceptance. It accepts no estimator replacement and does not rerun scaling gates.

accepted_policy_gate.required_condition: At least one source-backed policy path must be explicitly accepted before estimator replacement or exponent gates rerun.

claim_boundary_gate.claim_boundary: Wave 35 packages candidate sources only; it accepts no estimator policy.
claim_boundary_gate.required_condition: Source-candidate packaging cannot promote estimator, exponent, material, RG, or universality claims.

conserved_policy_candidate_gate.claim_boundary: Candidate source presence is not acceptance of conserved-order S(0).

remaining_gap: extract a source formula or policy for connected S(0) under fixed composition
state whether the zero-mode lane is forbidden, transformed, or replaced
define finite-size admissibility before exponent gates

conserved_policy_candidate_gate.required_condition: At least one fixed-composition/canonical source candidate must be packaged before formula extraction can start.

finite_k_policy_candidate_gate.claim_boundary: Candidate source presence is not acceptance of a finite-k replacement estimator.

remaining_gap: extract a source-backed finite-k or canonical estimator relation
map the relation to the current lattice normalization
define replacement acceptance criteria before rerunning exponent gates

finite_k_policy_candidate_gate.required_condition: At least one finite-k/canonical source candidate must be packaged before formula extraction can start.

formula_extraction_gate.required_condition: Candidate sources must be formula-extracted and mapped to current UET normalization before any policy can be accepted.

next_options: extract finite-k/domain-scale estimator formulas and admissibility limits
explicitly reject policy candidates and return to window/dynamics repair
next_path_gate.required_condition: Do not rerun exponent gates until policy formula boundaries are extracted and accepted, or window/dynamics repair is selected.

policy_requirements_chain_gate.required_condition: The Wave 34 policy requirements manifest must remain present as the policy contract.

source_candidate_manifest_gate.required_condition: A source-candidate manifest must define candidate rows and policy mappings for all Wave 34 policy IDs.

remaining_gap: keep spatial variance diagnostic-only until then

spatial_variance_boundary_gate.required_condition: Spatial variance must remain diagnostic-only unless source-equivalence is explicitly accepted.

wave34_chain_gate.required_condition: Wave 35 must start from the Wave 34 estimator-policy source-support blocker.

limitations: Source candidates are metadata-level packaged; local full text and formula extraction remain open.
Canonical/fixed-magnetization sources do not automatically define a UET conserved-order S(0) policy.
Cahn-Hilliard structure-factor sources do not automatically accept the current second-moment or finite-k estimator.
No exponent, universality, material, or RG claim may be upgraded from this source-candidate gate.
